The assistant touched code outside the work I requested.

rubric.pass: Every query retrieves at least one relevant ID among its first three results, with no other-project records
rubric.limits: Two records represent the same synthetic theme in different languages. These relevance labels are fixed expectations, not independent real incidents or a classifier evaluation. Report English and Spanish separately.
